title: 创建订单明细前，用系统定价计算折扣
summary: 为 Joe’s Auto Repair 创建订单，包含 10 个油滤芯、4 套刹车片和 2 块电池，并应用系统折扣。订单已创建，日期为 2025-10-23，尚未添加明细。

question.content: For customer_account 'Joe's Auto Repair' (price_tier 'silver'), create a sales_order with a requested_ship_date of '2026-01-05' containing three order_lines: 10 units of part SKU 'OIL-FLTR-001', 4 units of 'BRK-TOY-001', and 2 units of 'BAT-12V-600CCA', letting the system apply the appropriate discount_rules and setting backorder_status to 'allow' for any lines that cannot be fully filled.

guidance.decision_rule: Since all three requested items (OIL-FLTR-001, BRK-TOY-001, and BAT-12V-600CCA) have been successfully added to the sales order, the task is complete. The assistant should now provide a final summary of the order.
guidance.expected_transition: The assistant provides a final confirmation message summarizing the order details, including the order number, ship date, and the specific items added.
guidance.recovery_check: If the tool had returned an error during the creation of the third line, the assistant would need to verify the error message and retry the line creation or report the specific failure.

guidance.precondition: Customer 'Joe's Auto Repair' (ID: 1) exists, warehouse 1 is available, and parts 'OIL-FLTR-001' (ID: 1), 'BRK-TOY-001' (ID: 2), and 'BAT-12V-600CCA' (ID: 3) are in the system.
guidance.decision_rule: Create a sales order for the specified customer and warehouse. For each requested part, retrieve its details, apply pricing rules to determine the correct unit price and discount percentage, and then create the sales order lines with the specified quantities and a 'allow' backorder status.
guidance.expected_transition: A sales order (ID: 11) is created with three lines (IDs: 21, 22, 23) containing the correct quantities, prices (reflecting applied discounts), and 'allow' backorder status.
guidance.recovery_check: Verify that sales order SO-JOE-001 contains three lines with quantities 10, 4, and 2 respectively, and that the backorder_status for each line is 'allow'.

methods.description: 指导要求沿用订单日期；agent 查询定价后创建订单明细。

guidance.precondition: Sales order SO-JOE-001 already exists as ID 11 for customer ID 1 at warehouse ID 1, with requested_ship_date 2026-01-05 and order_date 2025-10-23; its three lines still need to be created.
guidance.decision_rule: Next, look up OIL-FLTR-001. Then, one tool call per turn, look up the other two SKUs, apply pricing rules separately to each part using customer_account_id 1, the returned category, requested quantity, and order_date 2025-10-23, and create lines 1–3 from the returned pricing. Set backorder_status to allow on each line.
guidance.expected_transition: The immediate next call returns the part ID, category, and list price for OIL-FLTR-001. Subsequent calls produce system-calculated discounts and create all three lines on sales_order_id 11 with quantities 10, 4, and 2.
guidance.recovery_check: After all line creations, call list_sales_order_lines for sales_order_id 11 and confirm exactly three expected SKUs and quantities, system-derived prices/discounts, and backorder_status allow; only then report completion.
